verses.text: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
lines: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath,
neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

verses.text: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
lines: For your arrows have pierced me,
your hand presses hard on me.

verses.text: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
lines: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation,
neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

verses.text: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
lines: For my iniquities have gone over my head.
As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

verses.text: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.
lines: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt
because of my foolishness.

verses.text: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
lines: I am in pain and bowed down greatly.
I go mourning all day long.

verses.text: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
lines: For my waist is filled with burning.
There is no soundness in my flesh.

verses.text: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
lines: I am faint and severely bruised.
I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

verses.text: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
lines: Lord, all my desire is before you.
My groaning is not hidden from you.

verses.text: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
lines: My heart throbs.
My strength fails me.
As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

verses.text: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
lines: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague.
My kinsmen stand far away.

verses.text: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
lines: They also who seek after my life lay snares.
Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things,
and meditate deceits all day long.

verses.text: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
lines: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear.
I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

verses.text: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
lines: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear,
in whose mouth are no reproofs.

verses.text: For I hope in you, Yahweh. You will answer, Lord my God.
lines: For I hope in you, Yahweh.
You will answer, Lord my God.

verses.text: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
lines: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me,
or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

verses.text: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
lines: For I am ready to fall.
My pain is continually before me.

verses.text: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
lines: For I will declare my iniquity.
I will be sorry for my sin.

verses.text: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
lines: But my enemies are vigorous and many.
Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

verses.text: They who render evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
lines: They who render evil for good are also adversaries to me,
because I follow what is good.

verses.text: Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.
lines: Don’t forsake me, Yahweh.
My God, don’t be far from me.

verses.text: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
lines: Hurry to help me,
Lord, my salvation.
